title: Collaborative Filtering Recommendations for User 1
description:
Recommend products for **user 1**. Similarity of another user is the count of shared products. Score a candidate product as the **sum of similarities of users who bought it**. Exclude products user 1 already bought. Return the top 3 by score, then product name.

**Table: purchases** — `user_id`, `product`

Output columns: `product`, `score`. Order by `score` DESC, `product`.
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE purchases (user_id INT, product VARCHAR); INSERT INTO purchases VALUES (1,'A'),(1,'B'),(2,'A'),(2,'B'),(2,'C'),(3,'A'),(3,'C'),(3,'D'),(4,'B'),(4,'C'),(4,'E');
solution_sql: WITH target AS (SELECT product FROM purchases WHERE user_id = 1), overlap AS (SELECT p.user_id, COUNT(*) AS shared FROM purchases p JOIN target t ON t.product = p.product WHERE p.user_id <> 1 GROUP BY p.user_id), recs AS (SELECT p.product, SUM(o.shared) AS score FROM purchases p JOIN overlap o ON o.user_id = p.user_id WHERE p.product NOT IN (SELECT product FROM target) GROUP BY p.product) SELECT product, score FROM recs ORDER BY score DESC, product LIMIT 3

test_cases.description: C scores 4; D and E score 1

hints: Join other users to user 1's products to count overlap.
Sum those overlap weights for every product those users bought that user 1 has not.
explanation: User 1 owns A and B. User 2 shares both (weight 2) and bought C. User 3 shares A (1) and bought C, D. User 4 shares B (1) and bought C, E. C = 2+1+1 = 4; D = 1; E = 1.
